soilLab.title: Viking's Soil Lab
soilLab.intro: Viking had tiny labs inside. Run all 3 experiments on the Mars soil, then decide what they prove.

experiments.label: Heat it up
experiments.action: Baking the soil in a tiny oven…
experiments.result: Earlier, the soil gave off gas. After the soil was heated, the strange reaction mostly stopped. Living things die in heat… but some chemicals also break down. So this clue could point either way! Confusing!

experiments.label: Feed it nutrients
experiments.action: Adding a nutrient "soup" to the soil…
experiments.result: Gas bubbled out! Living things can do that… but so can special chemicals in the soil.

experiments.label: Search for carbon molecules
experiments.action: Sniffing the soil with a gas detector…
experiments.result: No organic (carbon) molecules found. Life on Earth is built from them, so this is a big clue against life.

soilLab.question: So… did Viking prove there is life on Mars?

options.text: Yes! The gas bubbles mean aliens!
options.feedback: Not so fast, detective! Chemicals can make bubbles too, and no carbon molecules were found.

options.text: No. The soil reacted, but it might just be chemistry.
options.feedback: Exactly! Something happened, but there was no proof of life. That is how real scientists think.
Hmm, something DID happen. Look at the results again.

rockScanner.title: Opportunity's Rock Scanner
rockScanner.intro: Scan each rock. Find the 2 rocks that hold clues about ancient water.

rocks.name: Blueberry Rock
rocks.look: Covered in tiny round grey balls
rocks.scan: Hematite spheres! These "blueberries" formed inside rock soaked by water.

rocks.name: Layered Rock
rocks.scan: Fine layers plus salty minerals. Together they point to water that once soaked this rock.

rocks.name: Dark Rock
rocks.scan: Volcanic basalt. It cooled from lava, so it is not a water clue.

rocks.name: Dusty Rock
rocks.scan: Just an ordinary rock wearing a coat of Mars dust. No water clue.

rockScanner.wrongHint: Ziggy: Hmm, no water clue in that one. Try another rock!
rockScanner.success: Two water clues found! Water once soaked these rocks.

digSite.title: Phoenix's Dig Site
digSite.intro: Use the robotic arm: click the soil squares to dig a trench. Find the hidden white patches.
digSite.foundText: White lumps! Is it salt? Is it ice?
digSite.waitAction: Phoenix waits and takes a picture every day…
digSite.revealText: The white lumps VANISHED! Salt would have stayed. Ice slowly turns into vapor in Mars' thin air. It was WATER ICE!
